name: io.github.breachintelligence/polarity-mcp
title: Polarity
description: Connect Claude to your self-hosted Polarity instance to perform real-time threat intelligence lookups, parse indicators of compromise (IPs, domains, hashes, URLs), and query any of your configured integrations directly from a conversation.

environmentVariables.name: POLARITY_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: The base URL of your Polarity server, e.g. https://polarity.yourcompany.com

environmentVariables.name: POLARITY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Polarity API key. Generate one in Polarity under Settings > API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: POLARITY_IGNORE_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' if your Polarity server uses a self-signed certificate.

tools.name: list_available_integrations
tools.title: List Available Integrations
tools.description: Lists all running Polarity integrations accessible to the authenticated user, including name, ID, version, description, and supported entity types.

tools.name: do_integration_lookup
tools.title: Do Integration Lookup
tools.description: Parses entities from a query string and performs a threat intelligence lookup against the specified Polarity integration, returning enriched results.

tools.name: parse_entities
tools.title: Parse Entities
tools.description: Extracts typed indicators of compromise (IP addresses, domains, URLs, file hashes, email addresses) from free-form text.
